description: Source code for dump_symbols.cc, part of Google Breakpad, implementing functions to extract debugging symbols from ELF files and generate Breakpad symbol files.

classes.name: FDWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper to ensure file descriptors are closed properly.

classes.name: MmapWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper to ensure memory-mapped regions are unmapped properly.

classes.name: LoadSymbolsInfo
classes.description: Holds state for loading symbols, including debug section tracking and debug link info.

methods.description: Determines the preferred load address of an ELF binary.

methods.description: Loads STABS debugging info into a module.

methods.name: DwarfCFIRegisterNames

methods.name: LoadDwarfCFI
methods.description: Loads DWARF call frame info into a module.

methods.name: LoadELF
methods.description: Maps an ELF file into memory.
